settings.integrations.sheets.title: Google Sheets
settings.integrations.sheets.description: Every order is added to the “Commandes” tab and updated on every change (status, tracking, contact). One way: Djaber → Sheets.
settings.integrations.sheets.notConnecte: Connect your Google account, then choose or create the sheet: every new order will be added to it.
settings.integrations.sheets.filters.all: All sources (AI, manual, mobile, API, import)
settings.integrations.sheets.verificatio: ≤ 100 test users until Google approves the app.
settings.integrations.sheets.error.revok: Google removed Djaber’s access: syncing is paused. Reconnect Google to resume it.
settings.integrations.sheets.error.missi: The sheet was deleted or is no longer accessible: choose another sheet.
settings.integrations.sheets.returnError: The Google connection did not complete.
settings.integrations.sheets.toast.conne: Google account connected: choose the sheet.
The sheet is not deleted; syncing stops.
settings.integrations.sheets.backfill.co: Orders of the period are added to or updated in the sheet (backfill).
settings.integrations.sheets.backfill.hi: Background job · progress bar · orders already in the sheet are updated, never duplicated.
settings.integrations.sheets.backfill.do: Backfill finished: the sheet is up to date.
settings.integrations.sheets.dialog.pick: The Google picker could not open: paste the sheet URL.
settings.integrations.sheets.dialog.file: No sheet in this Drive: paste a URL or create one.
settings.integrations.sheets.dialog.pick: Choose a sheet in the list.
settings.integrations.sheets.dialog.urlH: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/… · the sheet must be accessible to your Google account
settings.integrations.sheets.dialog.urlI: Paste the full URL of a Google sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/…).
settings.integrations.sheets.dialog.crea: created in My Drive with the tab and the headers
settings.integrations.sheets.dialog.filt: Tick at least one page and one source, or keep “all”.
settings.integrations.sheets.dialog.rang: Optional: leave empty to send only new orders.
Invalid period: the start date must come before the end date.
settings.integrations.apiKeys.title: API keys
settings.integrations.apiKeys.descriptio: Server-to-server access, limited by scopes. The key is shown only once. {rate} requests / min per key.
settings.integrations.apiKeys.emptyHint: Create a key to connect your ERP, Zapier or a script to Djaber.
settings.integrations.apiKeys.usage: Header X-API-Key: dj_live_… (or Authorization: Bearer). Any route outside the key’s scopes answers 403 API_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN.
settings.integrations.apiKeys.field.name: Name
Accounting integration
settings.integrations.apiKeys.field.scop: Give only the scopes the integration needs.
settings.integrations.apiKeys.onceNote: Copy it now: it will never be shown again.
settings.integrations.apiKeys.headerHint: Send it in the X-API-Key header. A lost key is revoked and created again.
settings.integrations.apiKeys.revokeText: Calls with this key are refused immediately (API_KEY_REVOKED). Cannot be undone.
settings.integrations.webhooks.title: Outbound webhooks
settings.integrations.webhooks.descripti: HMAC signature (X-Djaber-Signature), 7 attempts (1 min → 24 h), disabled after 50 consecutive failures with a notification.
settings.integrations.webhooks.emptyHint: Add a URL to receive your shop’s events (orders, stock, customers).
settings.integrations.webhooks.disabledT: “{url}” disabled after {count} failures ({code}). Fix the endpoint then re-enable it; the last 50 deliveries can be replayed.
settings.integrations.webhooks.signature: Every delivery carries X-Djaber-Signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256(secret, “t.body”)>, X-Djaber-Event and X-Djaber-Delivery. Reject deliveries older than 5 min.
settings.integrations.webhooks.testSent: Ping event sent: the result arrives in the log.
settings.integrations.webhooks.replayed: “{event}” sent again: new delivery in the log.
settings.integrations.webhooks.deleteTex: “{url}” will no longer receive events. Deliveries are kept 30 days.
settings.integrations.webhooks.rotateTex: The old secret of “{url}” stops working immediately: update your server with the new one.
settings.integrations.webhooks.secretOnc: Copy it now: it will never be shown again.
settings.integrations.webhooks.journal.e: Deliveries show up here from the first event (or with “Test”). Kept 30 days.
